channel.title: The Longevity Engineers
channel.description: Silicon Valley engineers Scott and Jaggu take one longevity-science topic per episode — cholesterol, blood sugar, fiber, strength, skin aging — and reason it from first principles, the way you'd debug a system. No hype, no supplements to sell: just the core mechanisms so you can judge for yourself. English companion to the Mandarin show 抗老工程學.
channel.itunes:subtitle: Two engineers debug the biology of living longer.

item.title: 1 · Cholesterol: The Half-Century Misunderstanding
item.description: The most misunderstood molecule in modern health. Scott and Jaggu rebuild cholesterol from first principles: why every cell makes its own, why apo-B particle count — not 'good vs bad' — is the real crime scene, the five-step atherosclerosis cascade, statins, and what actually lowers your risk. General information, not medical advice.
